title: Repositories
intro: Git repositories the project's agents work on. Each one is cloned in repos/<name> of the project's workspace, where git signs in with its token.
empty: No repository yet. Add one and the project's agents can work on its code.

protection.unprotectedHint: Nothing on {provider} stops an agent from pushing straight to {branch}. The agents are told to open pull requests, but only a protection rule enforces it.
protection.unknownHint: The token cannot read the protection settings of {branch}.

add.title: Add a repository
add.description: Abotica checks with GitHub or GitLab that the token reaches the repository and can push to it.
add.urlHint: The address from the browser, or the clone address (HTTPS or SSH).
add.providerHint: {host} is a self-hosted server: choose what it runs.
add.nameHint: The agents find the clone in repos/{name}.
add.added: {name} added. The agents get it on their next run.
add.addedUnprotected: {name} added, but {branch} is not protected on {provider}.

token.githubHint: A fine-grained token with access to this repository only, and Contents and Pull requests set to Read and write.
token.gitlabHint: A project access token with the Developer role and the api and write_repository scopes. On GitLab.com without Premium, a personal access token with the same scopes.
token.githubTracking: To follow CI on the pull requests the agents open, the token also needs Actions and Commit statuses set to Read (the link sets them). Without them, merges and reviews are still followed.
token.gitlabTracking: With these scopes Abotica also follows the pipelines, discussions and merges of the merge requests the agents open.
token.shared: Every agent of the project can use the token inside the sandbox. Limit it to this repository.

replaceToken.title: Replace the token of {name}
replaceToken.description: The new token is checked before it replaces the current one.

delete.description: The agents lose access to {repo}. Its clone stays in the project's workspace, without credentials, until you reset the workspace.

errors.invalidUrl: This is not a repository address. Paste the address from the browser, such as https://github.com/acme/site.
errors.providerRequired: Choose whether the server runs GitHub or GitLab.
errors.invalidName: The folder name may use lowercase letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores, and must start with a letter or digit.
errors.alreadyAdded: This repository is already in the project.
errors.nameTaken: Another repository of the project already uses the folder {name}.
errors.tokenRejected: The token was rejected. Check that you copied all of it and that it has not expired.
errors.notFound: The token cannot see {repo}. Check the address and that the token has access to this repository.
errors.noPushAccess: The token can read the repository but not push to it.
errors.unreachable: {host} cannot be reached. Try again in a moment.
